about: The desktop app's file names on a GitHub release; {version} is the version without its v. Read by scripts/name-downloads.mjs, scripts/updater-manifest.mjs, scripts/sign-engine.mjs, site/lib/release.ts and desktop/src-tauri/build.rs. site/public/install.sh and install.ps1 spell them out, and scripts/check-release.mjs checks that they agree.
